{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Attention, people of Kessel!'' You will now suffer the ''consequences'' of ''not surrendering'' the ''Rebels'' on your planet to me!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]], adressing a message to the Kesselians of [[Little Kessel]]|<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />}}
The '''Kesselians''' were a cultural group of [[Human/Legends|humans]] who called the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]s of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Little Kessel]] [[Homeworld/Legends|home]], located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. 

==History==
{{Quote|Don't be a ''fool'', Volz&mdash;! You are disobeying ''Lord Vader's'' direct orders!''"<br />"''Do your ''worst,'' Bzorn! If Mira and I must give ''our lives'' to save the people of Kessel&hellip; then, so be it!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] and [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]]|<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Kesselians of [[Little Kessel]] lived peacefully on their lush, verdant [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="The Unseen Planets of Star Wars">{{InsiderCite|36|The Unseen Planets of Star Wars|The Unseen Planets of ''Star Wars''}}</ref> [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]] and his daughter [[Mira Volz]] were both Kesselians from Little Kessel who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Galactic Empire was aware that their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was home to hundreds of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. As a result, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Little Kessel aboard the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] and demanded that all Rebels on the planet be surrendered. When the government of Little Kessel refused, the Galactic Empire [[Devastation of Little Kessel|tormented]] the planet with [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and cyclones. By that time, Little Kessel had not experienced a groundquake in so many eons that the Kesselians did not even know what one was.<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], several [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Kesselian blockade runners]] from [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] were part of the [[Rebel Command Fleet|Rebel fleet]] that gathered near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] for the upcoming [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tessa Manchisco]] was surprised to find such [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] upon arriving in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]. She had expected to see [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Calamarians]] and [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], but she had not expected to see Kessel represented. Manchisco assumed these [[blockade runner]]s were from independents still fighting the Imperial government on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were sent on a [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|mission]] to the [[Kessendra Stadium]] on Kessel to spy the [[Kessendra Coronation]].<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Because C-3PO and R2-D2 had become so recognizable, they were respectively disguised as a [[Kesselian security droid]] and as a [[Kesselian spice-mining droid]] to ensure their anonymity on the mission.<ref name="SPIN Declassified">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|second draft]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grande Mouff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] was a thin, [[Bird/Legends|bird]]-like commander of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|outland]] [[Kesselian Dragoon]]s.<ref name="Second draft">''[[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars]]''</ref>
